definition: Completed local research application and documented experiment outcomes

foundation.explanation: Maintain reproducible environments and verify on a clean machine.

local_app.explanation: Local prototype; public deployment is tracked separately.

tumor.explanation: All three improved segmenters passed compatibility and development uncertainty checks. Classifier recalibration rejected; unchanged probabilities pass limited development checks (docs/TUMOR_CLASSIFIER_UNCERTAINTY.md). Patient independence and segmentation screening specificity remain unestablished; no promotion.

stroke.explanation: 0.65 rechecked and rejected: three newly zero-Dice patients. Fixed 0.55/component-filter correction passes 7/8 strengthened checks but still newly misses one patient. Baseline retained; improved candidate and cross-seed/independent confirmation remain.

ucsf.explanation: Three-seed fixed refinement completed: seed 44 improves Dice and false positives, but seeds 42/43 fail. Repeatable development improvement and original qualification remain unmet; no promotion.

leakage.explanation: User-requested resolve-or-document task complete across four local collections. Eight issues have explicit dispositions; unknown patient/cross-source exposure remains documented. Independence is not certified; the separate evaluation gate remains open.

review_tool.explanation: Local self-entered reviewer identities; does not certify expertise.

fusion.explanation: Weighted candidates failed improvement/no-new-miss checks. Experimental CLI now defaults to exact DWI baseline; ensemble requires explicit flag. ADC-only disabled. Better fusion candidates and independent evaluation remain.

uncertainty.explanation: Explicit reliability abstention integrated into inference, viewer and reports; classifier development cutoff bound to its checkpoint. Qualified coverage remains zero; useful independently reliable calibration/abstention is not established.

robustness.explanation: Requested extension completed: 721 tumor segmentation images and 37 DWI volumes under six conditions each, with hashed predictions and exact metric replay. Perturbation failures remain model-quality findings; independent scanner/site robustness is not established.

evidence.explanation: Validated physical volumes, original/canonical coordinates and source-bound finding links for the supported DWI/tumor paths. 49 synthetic geometries and 37 development volumes checked. Pixel-only tumor images; clinical mask accuracy and atlas/longitudinal registration are not claimed.

collaboration.explanation: Local accounts, two-reviewer assignments, blind mask uploads, adjudication and approved exports implemented. Requires real accounts/reviewers; remote deployment and correction rounds remain out of scope.

active.explanation: Selection connected to assignments, effort reports, adjudication and exports. Three-seed retrospective equal-budget benchmark complete: active Dice 0.2982 vs random 0.3354. Prospective human-time efficiency remains unproven.

promotion.explanation: Versioned labels, approved-export ingestion, three-architecture retraining, coverage and prediction evidence, acceptance assembly and reversible registry updates implemented. Real BRISC candidate rejected; baseline retained. Scientific gates are unchanged.

eeg.explanation: Existing 12 recordings: two-window confirmation reduces false alarms 722 to 591 (18.14%) and retains 4/4 development matches, but 59.3/hour remains excessive. Three retrained seeds missed 3/4 seizures and were rejected. A useful sensitivity/false-alarm tradeoff and independent reliability remain unmet; no downloads.

federated.explanation: Expanded recovery, serialized communication integrity/byte accounting and all four development evaluations verified. Partial delivery and committed recovery reproduce final weights exactly. Untouched evaluation remains unmet; no real-network/privacy qualification.

evaluation.explanation: Seven numeric engineering targets finalized and hash-bound; eligibility audit found zero cleared models. Executable protocol remains blocked by model-quality, cohort eligibility and justified acceptance prerequisites. No protected inference or independent completion claimed.

deployment.explanation: Offline wheel installation and three-model loading verified in a fresh directory using existing host dependencies; loopback HTTP checks passed. 173 private viewer files and two databases recovered; one-shot monitoring verified and flags one historical input rejection. Clean-machine installation and off-device disaster recovery remain unverified; public hosting is not enabled.

limitations: Local Windows environment only; no clean-machine, off-device recovery, public hosting or clinical certification claim
scope_amendment: User accepted completion as a research application with documented model limitations on 12 October 2026
